meta.title: Integrate Frankencoin: payments, wallets, DeFi and token issuers
meta.description: Four ways to plug into the decentralized Swiss franc: accept payments, list and offer savings, use ZCHF in DeFi, or list your token as collateral.

hero.title: Plug into the Swiss franc|that has no issuer.
hero.subtitle: ZCHF is a standard ERC-20 on Ethereum and several other chains. These are the four integrations we see most, each with one place to start.

items.title: Payments
items.description: Accept ZCHF in a shop, card programme or payroll. This track leads to the partner list, not to developer resources.

items.title: Wallets and exchanges
items.description: List ZCHF and offer your users a Swiss-franc balance that earns the savings rate.

items.title: DeFi protocols
items.description: Use ZCHF in pools, lending markets and vaults, with public price and supply data.

items.title: Token issuers
items.description: Let your holders borrow francs against your token by proposing it as collateral.

items.title: Mt Pelerin
items.description: Buy ZCHF against bank transfer into a self-custodial wallet.

items.title: DFX
items.description: Swiss on- and off-ramp between bank accounts and ZCHF.

items.title: Ammer.cash
items.description: Payment terminals and checkout that accept ZCHF.

items.title: Zippy
items.description: Consumer wallet with ZCHF balances and social recovery.

items.title: Aktionariat
items.description: Tokenized Swiss company shares traded against ZCHF.

cta.title: Not sure where you fit?
cta.body: Write to the association. One email is enough; grants are available for integrations.
